== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Firepower (V)]], showing the '''original''' game text. No published card image shows this text. The Players Committee card image ([[:File:VSh-D-firepower-pre.gif]]) shows the later PC-E1 text (“… may retrieve 1 Force.”).

* '''Text source:''' the Players Committee website card list (VShieldsType, 2012-07-21 capture: https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064820/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VShieldsType.html; same text in the captures of 13 December 2012 and 12 February 2013). Icons are drawn as on the printed slips.
* '''original text:''' “Plays on table. If opponent moves from a location you occupy during your turn, they lose 2 Force. At end of opponent's turn, if you control two battlegrounds (a site and system) and opponent deployed a card with ability and did not initiate a battle, you may retrieve 1 Force.”
* '''Made:''' 9 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 72): the card's own Virtual Legacy card (GEMP <code>601_36 / 1200_1</code>; printed frame, Decipher art, title, lore, icons and set mark as on the Players Committee card image) with the original game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
